title: Pointwise finite projective dimension of an affine polynomial presentation
statement: Let f : X → Y be a locally finite type morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with Y Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and HasStalkwiseFiniteTorDimension f [def-pc-perfect-morphism]. Let U and V be affine opens with V ⊆ f⁻¹(U), and g : R = Γ(Y,U)[t₁,...,tₙ] → Γ(X,V) a surjective homomorphism compatible with the coordinate map. Put M = Γ(X,V), viewed as an R-module through g. For every prime p of R there exists a natural d such that Ext^i_{R_p}(M_p,N) = 0 for every R_p-module N and every i ≥ d+1 [def-pc-ext]. Equivalently the categorical localized module has HasProjectiveDimensionLE M_p d. The bound may depend on p; n = 0 and M = 0 are allowed [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension].

source.place: Tag 069C, proof of (3) implies (1), and More on Algebra, Tag 068X; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/069C; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/068X

proof.text: A = Γ(Y,U) is Noetherian and R = A[t₁,...,tₙ] is Noetherian by the Hilbert basis theorem. The surjection g makes B = Γ(X,V) finite over R. Fix a prime q of R. If ker(g) is not contained in q, invert an element of ker(g) outside q: it is simultaneously invertible and annihilates B_q, so B_q = 0 and all its positive Ext groups vanish.

source.place: Tag 069C, proof of (3) implies (1), and More on Algebra, Tag 068X; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/069C; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/068X

proof.text: Otherwise q corresponds to a prime of B and hence a point x of V. The affine stalk/localization isomorphisms identify B_q with O_{X,x}, and A_p with O_{Y,f(x)}, where p is the contraction of q to A. The equation g.comp C = f.appLE identifies the scalar actions with the stalk map. HasStalkwiseFiniteTorDimension supplies a finite Tor bound over A_p.

source.place: Tag 069C, proof of (3) implies (1), and More on Algebra, Tag 068X; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/069C; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/068X

proof.text: The map A_p → R_q is flat; each of its fibres is a localization of a polynomial ring over a field and has global dimension at most n. B_q[0] is pseudo-coherent by the Noetherian finite-module property. Tag 068X makes it perfect over R_q. In a finite free resolution, dimension shifting and the finite Tor bound make a high syzygy flat; it is finitely presented, hence projective. Truncation gives a finite projective resolution. Computing Ext using that resolution yields a natural d with HasProjectiveDimensionLE B_q d. No global bound is chosen here.

lean.statement:
theorem affinePolynomial_localized_finiteProjectiveDimension_of_stalkwise
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (hperfect : HasStalkwiseFiniteTorDimension f)
    (U : Y.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (V : X.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (e : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (n : ℕ) (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) Γ(Y, U) →+* Γ(X, V))
    (hg : Function.Surjective g)
    (hcomp : g.comp (MvPolynomial.C) = (f.appLE U V e).hom) :
    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) Γ(Y, U)), ∃ d : ℕ,
      HasProjectiveDimensionLE
        (((ModuleCat.restrictScalars g).obj (ModuleCat.of Γ(X, V) Γ(X, V))).localizedModule
          p.asIdeal.primeCompl) d
